note: One author-written descriptor per topic workarea (ADR-0072 d2: summary at most 600 characters, at most 8 questions, about empty since no ontology terms are on main). Written from corpus.json alone, before queries.json was read, by the lane that ran the phase 2 gate on 2026-11-11; frozen with the results it produced. The adversarial descriptor is built by fed2.py from the query set and is not stored here.

api.summary: The public REST API of the invoicing service: URL versioning and the v1 sunset, the JSON error shape, cursor pagination and page sizes, idempotency keys on POST, the per-key rate limit and 429s, signed webhooks and their retries, the generated OpenAPI document, money as integer minor units with ISO 4217 codes, UTC timestamps, and the Kotlin and Ktor service with its JSON serialization and timeouts.
